name: Featherless AI
short: Serverless open-weights inference cloud hosting 40,000+ Hugging Face models; Chat (flat-rate) and Developer (per-token credits) plans.

plans.name: Chat
plans.notes: Flat-rate interactive chat for human-driven use: unlimited tokens, 32K context, 4 concurrent units; works with SillyTavern/RisuAI/Wyvern. Not for API/automation/reselling.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Per-token billing across any of 40,000+ models; context up to 256K, 100 concurrent units, unused credits roll over; for coding agents (Cline, OpenCode, etc.) and production API traffic.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Dedicated GPUs (H100, MI325X, B200, B300), no shared rate limits, private fine-tunes, named engineers and SLA; annual contracts.
